name: run-hosted-morphic-runtime
problem_solved: execute one bounded deterministic target-neutral Morphic core through hosted and fake machine-output implementations
selection_reasons: The resource planner derives fixed storage and initialization order.
The scheduler owns target-neutral time and runnable ordering policy.
The event trace records normalized bounded behavior.
inherited_guarantees: Fixed resource derivation, stable runnable ordering, caller-controlled time, bounded trace storage, and explicit capacity failures.
One shared core owns planning, scheduling, tracing, and output formatting; hosted and fake machines only provide bounded task output.
gaps_discovered: Linux userspace supplies process entry, stdout, exit, stack/bootstrap, and panic behavior; privileged execution, boot orchestration, firmware output, and hardware remain out of scope.
